papers.title: Astrocytes regulate axonal mitochondrial transport deficits in C9ORF72 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis motor neurons
papers.abstract: Astrocytes regulate axonal mitochondrial transport in motor neurons through mitochondrial bioenergetics, a process disrupted in C9ORF72-mediated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Enhancing astrocytic mitochondrial metabolism restores transport deficits.
papers.titleZh: 星形膠質細胞調控 C9ORF72 漸凍症運動神經元軸突粒線體運輸缺陷
papers.summaryZh: 該研究指出星形膠質細胞透過粒線體生物能量學調控運動神經元的軸突粒線體運輸。在 C9ORF72 介導的肌萎縮性脊髓側索硬化症中，此過程受干擾。研究發現增強星形膠質細胞的粒線體代謝可恢復運輸缺陷。此結果顯示星形膠質細胞對運動神經元軸突粒線體運輸具有調控作用。

papers.title: Diverse infections transcriptionally reprogram the intestinal epithelium and epithelial–immune cell interactions
papers.abstract: In this Resource, Beiting and colleagues provide an atlas of the mouse ileum and mesenteric lymph nodes under homeostatic conditions and during enteric infection. They also present GutPath, a tool that enables interrogation of the dataset.
papers.titleZh: 多樣感染重編程腸上皮與上皮-免疫細胞交互
papers.summaryZh: Beiting 等人在此 Resource 中提供小鼠回腸與腸系膜淋巴結在穩態條件以及腸道感染期間的圖譜。研究涵蓋多樣感染對腸上皮的轉錄重編程及其與免疫細胞交互的變化。作者同時推出 GutPath 工具，用以查詢該資料集。該圖譜與工具可供後續探討腸道感染下上皮與免疫互動的變化。

papers.title: Single-Cell Behavioromics Enables Fate Prediction of Individual Hematopoietic Stem Cells
papers.abstract: Achieving near-single-cell precision in the prospective identification of long-term engrafting hematopoietic stem cells (LT-HSCs) remains challenging, likely because current static, point-in-time single-cell phenotyping technologies do not capture the dynamic nature of cell fate decisions. Here, we overcome this barrier by longitudinally tracking individual hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) in ex vivo niche cultures using live imaging, coupled with downstream immunophenotyping, single-cell transcriptomics, and transplant assays. Deep learning analysis of live imaging data achieved 98.5% average precision in predicting serially-engrafting LT-HSC (serial-LT-HSC) identity from the behaviorome (the totality of observed behaviors) of each cell, outperforming currently available technologies. Serial-LT-HSCs exhibited lower motility among HSPC populations, which was associated with reduced Activin signaling activity and elevated expression of cell adhesion genes. Correspondingly, antagonizing Activin signaling by Inhibin-A treatment in ex vivo niche cultures suppressed HSPC motility while increasing the frequency of post-expansion serial-LT-HSCs, revealing a novel role for Activin signaling in HSPC behavior and fate determination. Collectively, this study establishes a broadly applicable framework that connects behavioromic analysis and single-cell transcriptomics to enable near-single-cell precision in predicting stem cell fate and uncover molecular mechanisms governing behavior-fate relationships.
papers.titleZh: 單細胞行為組學可預測個別造血幹細胞命運
papers.summaryZh: 本研究以活細胞影像縱向追蹤體外微環境培養中的個別造血幹細胞與前驅細胞，並結合下游免疫表型分析、單細胞轉錄組學與移植實驗。深度學習分析活細胞影像資料後，以行為組學預測可連續植入的長期造血幹細胞身份，平均精確度達98.5%，表現優於現有技術。可連續植入的長期造血幹細胞在HSPC族群中呈現較低的遷移性，並與較低的Activin訊號活性及較高的細胞黏附基因表現相關。體外微環境培養中以Inhibin-A拮抗Activin訊號可抑制HSPC遷移性，同時提高擴增後可連續植入的長期造血幹細胞頻率。研究建立了連結行為組學分析與單細胞轉錄組學的框架，用於近單細胞精度的幹細胞命運預測。

papers.title: A Measure of Transcriptional Dyscoordination for Quantifying Aging in Single Cells
papers.abstract: Aging reshapes tissues through changes in cellular composition, coordinated transcriptional reprogramming, and loss of transcriptional coordination. Whereas the first two have been characterized across aging tissues, the third remains difficult to quantify. We introduce an unsupervised, first-principles framework for measuring transcriptional dyscoordination in single cells as deviation from a learned, predictable structure accounting for technical noise. Orthogonal validation links transcriptional dyscoordination to classical intrinsic noise and distinguishes it from coordinated change. In controlled perturbations, dyscoordination rises after genotoxic injury and senescence induction, then falls following senolytic depletion. Across mouse, rat, and human tissues, dyscoordination increases with chronological age, especially in regenerative compartments. In human T cells, dyscoordination increases with clonal expansion and effector function yet declines within persisting clones after checkpoint blockade. Cross-modal analyses further link dyscoordination to chromatin-based mitotic age and genome instability. These results identify loss of transcriptional coordination as a distinct and dynamic feature of cellular aging.
papers.titleZh: 單細胞轉錄失協的量化指標與衰老關聯
papers.summaryZh: 研究團隊提出一種無監督、基於第一原理的框架，用以測量單細胞的轉錄失協程度，並將其定義為偏離可學習、可預測結構且已校正技術雜訊的偏差。驗證顯示轉錄失協與經典的內在雜訊相關，並可與協調性變化區分。在受控擾動中，基因毒性傷害與衰老誘導後失協上升，衰老細胞清除後則下降。跨小鼠、鼠與人類組織的分析顯示失協隨實際年齡增加，尤其在再生區室更明顯。人類T細胞中，失協隨克隆擴張與效應功能增加而上升，但在免疫檢查點阻斷後持續存留的克隆內下降。跨模態分析亦將失協與染色質基礎的粒線體年齡及基因組不穩定性連結。

papers.title: Exploring the Comedone Switch through Single-Cell Resolution of Human Acne Lesions
papers.abstract: Acne vulgaris is one of the most prevalent inflammatory skin diseases worldwide, yet the molecular events initiating comedogenesis remain poorly understood. The comedone switch hypothesis proposes that acne originates from an imbalance in lineage commitment within the junctional zone of the pilosebaceous unit, promoting infundibular differentiation at the expense of sebaceous gland maintenance. However, direct evidence from human acne tissue at single-cell resolution has been lacking. Here, we integrated single-cell transcriptomic datasets from healthy skin, nonlesional skin of acne patients, and lesional acne tissue to investigate early transcriptional changes associated with comedogenesis. We identified a previously uncharacterized cell population in nonlesional skin with transcriptomic features suggestive of a microcomedone-like state and mapped this population across independent datasets to characterize its relationship to comedonal keratinocytes. Comedonal remodeling was characterized by enhanced keratinization and inflammatory programs. Quantitative analyses supported a shift from sebaceous toward infundibular cell fate, providing data-driven support for the comedone switch hypothesis in human acne. Beyond the pilosebaceous unit, we identified broader epithelial alterations, including loss of POSTN and ERRFI1 expression in basal interfollicular epidermal keratinocytes. Together, these findings provide a cell-resolved view of transcriptional changes associated with human comedogenesis and highlight candidate pathways that may contribute to lineage imbalance within the upper hair follicle.
papers.titleZh: 單細胞解析人類痤瘡病灶 探索粉刺轉換機制
papers.summaryZh: 本研究整合健康皮膚、痤瘡患者非病灶皮膚與病灶痤瘡組織的單細胞轉錄組資料集，探討與粉刺生成相關的早期轉錄變化。作者在非病灶皮膚中發現一個先前未被描述的細胞族群，其轉錄特徵提示類似微粉刺狀態，並將此族群在獨立資料集中進行映射以描述其與粉刺角質細胞的關係。粉刺重塑表現為角化與發炎程序增強，定量分析支持從皮脂腺向 infundibular 細胞命運的轉移，為人類痤瘡的粉刺轉換假說提供數據支持。除毛囊皮脂單位外，研究亦發現更廣泛的上皮改變，包括基底間毛囊表皮角質細胞中 POSTN 與 ERRFI1 表現下降。

papers.title: Single-cell informed metabolic modeling reveals organ-specific metabolic adaptations in breast cancer organotropism
papers.abstract: Breast cancer organotropism is driven by interactions between tumor cells and organ-specific microenvironments that support metastatic growth. To better understand the metabolic basis of organ-specific metastasis, we integrated single-cell transcriptomics with constraint-based systems biology to generate context-specific metabolic models of breast cancer metastasis to the liver, bone, and brain. Our analysis identified both common and organ-specific metabolic changes, suggesting that metastatic cells share a core metabolic program while also adapting to the metabolic environment of each target organ. Primary tumors with metastatic potential showed early alterations in nucleotide metabolism, transport reactions, and energy-related pathways, indicating metabolic changes before metastatic spread. Metabolic transformation analysis identified key metabolic regulators involved in the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle, oxidative phosphorylation, redox balance, and metabolite transport. Integration with CRISPR gene essentiality data further highlighted metabolically important genes as potential therapeutic targets. In addition, analysis of organ-specific secreted metabolites revealed distinct metabolic signatures associated with metastatic colonization of the liver, bone, and brain. Overall, our single-cell-informed metabolic modeling approach shows that breast cancer organotropism is associated with both shared and organ-specific metabolic adaptations. The study provides a framework for identifying potential metabolic vulnerabilities that could be targeted to treat metastatic breast cancer.

papers.title: Single-Cell Sequencing in Pediatric Acute Leukemia: A Systematic Review of Biologic Insights and Translational Potential
papers.abstract: Background: Relapse remains the principal cause of treatment failure in pediatric acute leukemia. Clinically validated minimal residual disease (MRD) assays - multiparameter flow cytometry, immunoglobulin/T-cell-receptor rearrangement sequencing, and targeted next-generation sequencing panels -- are highly sensitive but read out predefined features and do not reconstruct clonal architecture or link a cell's genotype to its functional state. We systematically reviewed what single-cell sequencing has revealed about clonal evolution, chemoresistance, the immune microenvironment, and post-therapeutic immune dynamics in this disease. Methods: This review followed PRISMA 2020. PubMed/MEDLINE, the Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar were searched to September 2026 for primary studies applying single-cell DNA, RNA, chromatin-accessibility, surface-protein, or immune-repertoire sequencing to pediatric acute leukemia samples or pediatric-derived models. Risk of bias in non-randomized studies was assessed with ROBINS-I. Because designs, platforms, and outcomes were heterogeneous, findings were synthesized narratively by biologic theme without meta-analysis, following the SWiM guideline. Results: Of 63 records identified, 10 studies were included (published 2016-2026; 6-159 patients or samples per study; up to ~700,000 cells profiled). Single-cell DNA sequencing traced minor NOTCH1-mutant diagnostic subclones into PTEN- or TP53-mutant relapse clones that bulk sequencing missed. Rare dormant, label-retaining cells and developmental-state-dependent drug sensitivity defined chemoresistant compartments. Remodeling of the bone marrow immune microenvironment identified patients with adverse outcome among those classified as MRD-low, and pre-infusion CAR T-cell type 2 functionality and post-transplant cytotoxic memory CD8+ T-cell subsets were associated with durable remission. Of the seven studies assessed with ROBINS-I, four were at moderate and three at serious overall risk of bias, driven chiefly by small, selected cohorts. Conclusions: Single-cell sequencing yields mechanistic insight that complements, rather than replaces, clinically validated MRD assays, and nominates candidate biomarkers for risk stratification, treatment selection, cell-therapy manufacturing, and post-transplant monitoring. The evidence remains preliminary; adequately powered, prospective, and harmonized studies are required before clinical adoption.

papers.title: Integrated Lineage Tracing in Hepatoblastoma Finds a Plasticity-Proliferation Axis Drives Adaptation
papers.abstract: Paediatric cancers, with their developmental context and low mutational burden, are powerful models for studying plasticity in cancer evolution. Hepatoblastoma (HB) has among the lowest mutational burdens of childhood cancers, yet ~20% relapse, implicating non-genetic mechanisms in treatment adaptation. We integrate expressed DNA barcodes with longitudinal single-cell multiomics to trace clonal and phenotypic dynamics following cisplatin treatment in HB cell lines. Cisplatin imposes a phenotypic bottleneck, selecting for progenitor-like cells across clones without a clonal sweep. Exit from persistence involves asynchronous, partly fitness-biased re-expansion and re-diversification towards hepatocytic-like states, also captured in two longitudinal patient cases. Pseudotime and dynamical-landscape analyses reveal a plasticity-proliferation axis underlying recovery, where persister cells occupy an arrested-plastic state, exited to restart proliferation. Chromatin and regulatory analyses identify the E2F target BIRC5 (survivin) as a key node in this axis, epigenetically primed post-recovery. BIRC5 maintains hepatocytic-like states, and its knockdown shifts cells toward progenitor-like phenotypes, while pharmacological inhibition selectively eliminates cisplatin-tolerant persisters. These findings position BIRC5 as a regulator of plasticity-driven adaptation and a candidate vulnerability in the minimal-residual disease window.
papers.titleZh: 肝母細胞瘤中可塑性-增殖軸驅動適應
papers.summaryZh: 研究整合表現型DNA條碼與縱向單細胞多體學，追蹤肝母細胞瘤細胞株經順鉑治療後的克隆與表型動態。順鉑造成表型瓶頸，選擇跨克隆的祖細胞樣細胞，但未出現克隆掃蕩。從持續狀態退出時，細胞以非同步且部分受適存度影響的方式重新擴張並多樣化回肝細胞樣狀態，此模式亦見於兩例縱向病人樣本。偽時間與動態景觀分析顯示一條可塑性-增殖軸，持續細胞處於停滯-可塑狀態，退出後重新啟動增殖。染色質與調控分析指出E2F靶點BIRC5（survivin）為該軸的關鍵節點，其在恢復後被表觀遺傳性致敏；BIRC5維持肝細胞樣狀態，其敲降使細胞轉向祖細胞樣表型，藥理抑制則可選擇性清除順鉑耐受的持續細胞。

papers.title: AP-1 Primes Transcriptional Noise-Led Cancer Treatment Adaptation Through KDM5 Chromatin Rewiring
papers.abstract: How drug-tolerant persister (DTP) cells escape quiescence to drive tumour relapse remains a central unresolved question in cancer evolution. Here, we use neuroblastoma and hepatoblastoma, paediatric cancers with low genetic instability, as tractable model systems to study the principles and molecular mechanisms key in the early stages of adaptation to treatment. We identify transcriptional noise, the stochastic variability in gene expression, as a latent cellular property amplified post-treatment, during awakening from persistence, which drives adaptive regrowth following therapy withdrawal. Through functional assays, lineage tracing and single-cell multiomics, we show that treatment enriches for progenitor-like tolerant states with limited detectable clonal selection. Upon drug withdrawal, awakening proceeds via a stochastic process driven by noise-enabled plasticity in cell identity programmes. Mechanistically, AP-1-bound chromatin states emerge post-treatment, and AP-1 activity primes KDM5A recruitment to cell-state identity genes during awakening, driving H3K4me3 peak narrowing at their promoters and an increase in transcriptional noise that enables MES-to-ADRN plasticity. Pharmacological or genetic inhibition of AP-1 or KDM5 activity suppresses transcriptional noise and phenotypic plasticity, blocks DTP exit and prevents tumour recovery in both neuroblastoma and hepatoblastoma models. Together, these results identify KDM5-mediated transcriptional noise, operating within AP-engaged chromatin landscapes, as a key driver of early adaptation to treatment. Targeting this axis offers a strategy to exploit DTP awakening as an evolutionary bottleneck to prevent treatment adaptation and cancer relapse.
papers.titleZh: AP-1 透過 KDM5 染色質重塑 促進轉錄噪音引發的治療適應
papers.summaryZh: 本研究以神經母細胞瘤與肝母細胞瘤為模型探討藥物耐受持續細胞如何從休眠中復甦並驅動腫瘤復發。作者發現治療後在細胞甦醒期間，轉錄噪音被放大，並在缺乏明顯克隆選擇的情況下富集前驅樣耐受狀態。機制上，治療後出現 AP-1 結合的染色質狀態，AP-1 活性在甦醒時促進 KDM5A 招募至細胞狀態身份基因，導致啟動子處 H3K4me3 峰值收窄、轉錄噪音增加並使 MES-to-ADRN 可塑性得以進行。藥理或遺傳性抑制 AP-1 或 KDM5 活性可降低轉錄噪音與表型可塑性，阻斷 DTP 退出並在兩種模型中防止腫瘤恢復，顯示該軸線可作為利用 DTP 甦醒作為演化瓶頸以預防復發的策略。

papers.title: Dynamic Schlafen 11 (SLFN11) expression revealed by single-cell RNA sequencing of clonal human cancer cells
papers.abstract: Schlafen 11 (SLFN11) is a key determinant of sensitivity to DNA-damaging therapies in multiple cancers including leukemia, Ewing sarcoma, head and neck cancers, mesothelioma and small cell lung cancer (SCLC). Here, utilizing immunofluorescence microscopy and single-cell RNA sequencing we characterized SLFN11 expression across eight different human cancer cell lines and found cell-to-cell heterogenous expression both at the protein and RNA levels. Gene set enrichment and pathway analyses show that SLFN11 is coexpressed with a distinct stress-response state and enhanced genome maintenance programs while being inversely correlated with protein translation pathways. Publicly available single-cell RNA-sequencing datasets of human SCLC tumors confirmed the heterogeneous distribution of SLFN11 expression and confirmed its association with replication-related transcriptional programs. These findings indicate that heterogeneous SLFN11 expression reflects dynamic regulation at the single-cell level. They also underscore the limitations of bulk proteomic and transcriptome profiling and point to a potential reservoir of intrinsic chemotherapy resistance.
papers.titleZh: 單細胞定序揭示克隆人類癌細胞中 Schlafen 11 動態表現
papers.summaryZh: 本研究利用免疫螢光顯微鏡與單細胞 RNA 定序，分析八種人類癌細胞株的 Schlafen 11（SLFN11）表現，發現蛋白質與 RNA 層面皆存在細胞間異質性。基因集富集與路徑分析顯示 SLFN11 與特定的壓力反應狀態及強化之基因體維護程序共表現，並與蛋白質轉譯路徑呈負相關。公開的人類小細胞肺癌腫瘤單細胞 RNA 定序資料集亦證實 SLFN11 表現的異質分布，並與複製相關轉錄程序相關。作者指出異質性表現反映單細胞層級的動態調控，並凸顯大量蛋白質體與轉錄體分析的限制，可能構成內在化療抗藥性的儲備。

papers.title: High-resolution binding data of TFIID and cofactors show promoter-specific differences
papers.abstract: Here, the authors use ChIP-nexus to map all TFIID subunits and cofactors across the Drosophila genome at base pair resolution, revealing a general TFIID organization across promoter types with promoter-specific TBP and NC2 binding.
papers.titleZh: 高解析度 TFIID 與輔助因子結合數據展現啟動子特異性差異
papers.summaryZh: 本研究利用 ChIP-nexus 技術，以鹼基對解析度在果蠅基因體上繪製了所有 TFIID 次單元與輔助因子的圖譜。結果揭示了跨越不同啟動子類型的通用 TFIID 組織形式，同時顯示出具啟動子特異性的 TBP 與 NC2 結合情形。這項高解析度數據有助於深入理解基因轉錄起始的調控機制。

papers.title: A cytidine deaminase biodegrader sensitises multiple cancer types to deoxycytidine analogue-based chemotherapies
papers.abstract: Deoxycytidine (dC) analogues form the basis of many chemotherapeutic agents but their efficacy is limited by cytidine deaminase-mediated inactivation. Here, the authors develop an intracellular biodegrader targeting cytidine deaminase, capable of sensitising multiple cancer types to dC analogues.
papers.titleZh: 細胞內細胞苷脫氨酶降解器提升去氧胞苷類化療藥物敏感性
papers.summaryZh: 去氧胞苷類類似物是許多化療藥物的基礎，但其療效受細胞苷脫氨酶介導的失活所限制。研究團隊開發了一種針對細胞苷脫氨酶的細胞內降解器。該降解器可使多種癌症類型對去氧胞苷類似物為基礎的化療藥物產生敏感性。

papers.title: Neonatal overfeeding accelerates age-related sarcopenia and metabolic disorders through lifelong gut mucosa and microbiota programming in mice
papers.abstract: Here, the authors demonstrate that neonatal overfeeding in mice shortens lifespan and accelerates late-life muscle loss. This originates from persistent gut mucus defects and depleted Akkermansia muciniphila, revealing a targetable developmental origin for sarcopenia.
papers.titleZh: 新生期過度餵養透過腸道黏膜與菌群的終身程式化加速小鼠年齡相關肌少症與代謝異常
papers.summaryZh: 本研究在小鼠中探討新生期過度餵養的長期影響。作者發現新生期過度餵養會縮短壽命並加速晚年肌肉流失。該效應源自持續性的腸道黏液缺陷以及 Akkermansia muciniphila 的減少。研究指出此為肌少症可被標靶的發育起源。論文發表於 Nature Communications。

papers.title: Meta-analysis of empirical evidence on biodiversity and the risk of asthma
papers.abstract: Biodiversity loss is associated with several adverse health effects. Here, the authors report the results of a meta-analysis investigating the effect of exposure to high environmental and human biodiversity on the risk of asthma.
papers.titleZh: 生物多樣性與氣喘風險的統合分析
papers.summaryZh: 本研究為統合分析，探討暴露於高環境與人類生物多樣性對氣喘風險的影響。作者指出生物多樣性喪失與多項不良健康效應相關。研究彙整實證資料以檢視生物多樣性與氣喘風險的關聯。結果有助於了解環境多樣性暴露與氣喘風險之間的證據現況。

The WorkReach model for urban work location choices through economic complexity and informality
paper.abstract: The WorkReach model captures how economic opportunity and informality shape commuting. Analyzing four major cities, this study shows that measuring job access by perceived benefits, not just proximity, exposes hidden socioeconomic disparities.

paper.title: Trillion-scale integrated framework for high-throughput materials databases and seamless sharing
paper.abstract: A new computing framework builds large-scale materials databases under resource constraints, with major gains in efficiency, storage, and query speed plus edge-device deployment. A ten-trillion-scale HEA database was built in one week.

paper.title: Interfacial ferroelectricity at naturally-formed van der Waals interfaces
paper.abstract: The authors show that naturally formed interfaces in van der Waals SnSe2 host switchable electric polarization driven by atomic-layer sliding, offering a scalable platform for low-power memory and in memory computing.
